about: MindGame bullets (2.70). Each bullet is a buyer / seller behaviour from a course or transcript, written as ACTIVITY (Mandeep, 12 Nov 2026: 'points, level ke number nahi, activity kya ho rahi hai ye dekhna hai'). No fixed points, rupees or minutes: every check is measured in the symbol's own typical candle on the timeframe it is read on (live/mindgame.py, the gun). who: buyers / sellers / both. detect: the gun's activity check. side: +1 the bullet expects up, -1 down, 0 information only (not graded). All bullets start on trial: shown on the Chart page, recorded and graded (right / wrong / flat), never an alert. Mandeep, 12 Nov 2026: a bullet reaches the alerts only when its record is positive (trust below); until then it stays out of the alerts. status 'later' = needs data the app does not join yet.

bullets.activity: Big gap above yesterday's high, and the first candles sell
bullets.prediction: Yesterday's buyers book profit early: an early dip or stall, no fresh buying at the open

bullets.activity: One straight run from support into resistance (no rest), then a break
bullets.prediction: Trap breakout: profit booking near resistance makes it fail

bullets.activity: Time spent near resistance (small candles, consolidation), then a strong break
bullets.prediction: Real breakout: old buyers are out, new buyers in; buyers strong, the move runs

bullets.activity: Price works near a level and the lows do not break (highs, for sellers)
bullets.prediction: The side holding wins: a break the same way

bullets.activity: Hammer / shooting star confirmed at an extreme
bullets.prediction: Works only after a strong move (positions to book); inside a flat range it fails

bullets.activity: A slow, weak fall (small candles, no strength); mirror: slow weak rise
bullets.prediction: Someone is absorbing on the other side: no bounce / reversal trade yet

bullets.activity: A selling candle closes below the last buying candle's low (mirror for sellers)
bullets.prediction: That side is leaving: book into weakness, the move turns

bullets.activity: Price rejected just below the big call-OI strike (above the put-OI strike); or accepted beyond it
bullets.prediction: Option writers defend the strike; acceptance beyond it = they cover, the move runs
Above: buyers lead the day, the close supports; below: sellers lead, it caps

bullets.activity: After a strong fall most of it is taken back (mirror after a strong rise)
bullets.prediction: Most of that side has exited: price tends to reach the high (low) again
Trapped positions cover toward yesterday's close (gap fill)

bullets.activity: Small candles in a tight range: both sides build positions; then a close out of it
bullets.prediction: The losing side is trapped at the break: a fast move the breakout's way

bullets.activity: After a breakout price comes back to the level and holds
bullets.prediction: Right-entry buyers defend it: the move continues
